sam: Quick follow-up from the RFC — we need a lightweight plan for cross-model precision stitching (when a request is routed from fp8 -> int8 variant or vice-versa). Main worry: output discontinuities at stitch points causing hallucination spikes.
neha: Agreed. Propose a small 'stitch map' per model-version that lists switchable layer anchors and recommended warmup tokens. Keep it tiny. :+1:
juan: Sketch: stitch map entry = (anchor_layer, pre_norm_scale, post_norm_scale, min_warmup). e.g. `{anchor:20, pre_s:0.98, post_s:1.02, warmup:6}` — simple floats.
marta: How to expose? add `precision_stitch` to the model manifest and an /inspect API that returns the stitch map for a variant.
neha: Add onboarding validator that runs stitch transitions with smoke prompts and flags >10% delta on our loss/quality metrics.
ops-bot: deploy-check: model-manifest-validator passed for model/galen-v2-int8 (CI #4128). No stitch map present.
sam: Plan: short-term = manifest + runtime flag + smoke gating; medium-term = stitcher service that does KV blending + temp ramp + telemetry.
juan: Runtime heuristic: linear interpolation of KV scales over first N tokens. Guard: if per-token perplexity ratio > 2.0 then route to baseline. Pseudo: ```if perp_ratio > 2.0: route = baseline```
marta: I'll own the validator + start a 5% shadow routing fp8->int8 for gen-qa. Will collect prompt-level deltas.
neha: For smoke eval thresholds: warn at 5% quality drop, block at 12%. Also record top-k probability shifts.
sam: Actions: @marta add validator and run shadow (Tue), @juan prototype stitch interpolation (Wed), @neha add gating to eval harness. Revisit after shadow run. Thanks.
